title: Dynamic-Static Decomposition for Novel View Synthesis of Dynamic Scenes with Spiking Neurons

layout.note: Two columns of three lettered panels. The wide left column stacks (A) the baseline pipeline, (B) mask priors and (C) tag representation, with (B) and (C) in dashed orange and teal frames and split into an Others half and an Ours half. The narrow right column stacks (D), (E) and (F) in solid green, orange and teal frames, each with Others and Ours renders and colour-framed crops; the orange and teal frames repeat those of (B) and (C).

lesson: Split every panel into an Others half and an Ours half so that each design choice is contrasted on one canvas, then repeat the frame colour of each issue panel on the result panel that shows its effect. Dashed frames suit schematics and solid frames suit rendered results.
